title: Spearow's Half-Mile Danger Signal
premise: Spearow’s cry can be heard over half a mile away, and its echoing call signals danger to other Spearow.
audiencePromise: See why Spearow’s far-reaching cry is more than a loud noise.
openLoop: Why is an echoing cry a Spearow danger signal?
payoff: When Spearow’s high cry echoes all around, it is a sign they are warning each other of danger.
engagementQuestion: More impressive: half-mile reach or its danger signal?

voice.instructions: Urgent and amazed. Start tight and quiet, then build with each expanding soundwave. Land the final question with a playful challenge.
